interface.title: Brain Activity Monitor (Streamlit dashboard)
interface.field: Neuroscience / consumer EEG (Muse headband), cognitive-state monitoring
interface.stage_of_work: Online application of an offline-calibrated, rule-based classifier: replaying recordings or monitoring a live stream
interface.what_it_is_for: Replay a Muse EEG CSV recording (or connect to a live LSL stream) as a live 4-channel trace. A threshold engine labels each 4-second window Concentrating, Neutral or Relaxed with a confidence score, and the dashboard shows signal quality, connection status and statistics.

data.note: The Recording dropdown lists three CSVs in data/raw/: subjecta-concentrating-1.csv, subjecta-neutral-1.csv and subjecta-relaxed-1.csv. These are not recordings shipped with the tool. The run harness generated them as synthetic signals about 0.4 s long, each tuned toward one state, and they loop during replay. There is no upload widget. LSL mode had no hardware, so it only reached its timeout error.

tree.general: Watch a recorded or live brain-signal stream get classified into mental states, window by window, and judge whether to trust the result
tree.specific: Replay a Muse EEG CSV and watch the threshold engine label 4 s windows Concentrating/Neutral/Relaxed, with confidence, electrode quality and statistics

features.name: Stream source selector with replay/live modes
features.general: Pick where a signal stream comes from (a stored file replayed in real time or a live device), set options for that source, and restart the stream
features.specific: Sidebar Mode csv|lsl. In csv mode: Recording dropdown and Loop recording. In lsl mode: a hint about running 'muselsl stream' and a Discovery timeout slider (2–30 s). Changing any option rebuilds the pipeline, and the Connection panel shows the result. The Restart stream button appears only before the first window or in error/stopped states. Once a window renders it disappears, because the script stops on the decision-log ImportError
steps: Choose a mode in the Mode dropdown
In csv mode pick a recording and choose whether to loop it; in lsl mode set the discovery timeout
Change any option to restart, or press Restart stream where it is shown
Read Source, Status (streaming, stopped or error) and any error message in the Connection panel
serves_tasks: Replay a stored recording as if it were live
Connect to a live acquisition device instead of a file
Option: replay a short recording once, without looping

features.name: Connection status card
features.general: Show which data source is active, whether it is streaming, device identity and battery, and explain any connection failure
features.specific: 🔌 Connection panel: Source (CSV/LSL), Status pill (🟢 streaming / 🔴 error), Device, Battery, and a red error box with the timeout message. Its 🔍 Search Muse button is a stub that only reports 'Muse device discovery is not implemented yet'
steps: Start a stream from the sidebar
Read the status pill and device fields
On error, read the explanation box
serves_tasks: Confirm the source is connected and each sensor gives usable signal
Connect to a live acquisition device instead of a file

features.name: Per-channel signal quality badges
features.general: Estimate from the raw signal whether each sensor channel is usable and show it as a coloured badge per channel
features.specific: 🎚️ Electrode Quality grid for TP9, AF7, AF8 and TP10. Badges show n/a before data, then good/… from saturation, amplitude and variance checks (src.dashboard.signal_quality). They reset to n/a when the stream restarts
steps: Start streaming
Wait for the first samples (badges go n/a → good)
Check every channel before trusting a classification
serves_tasks: Confirm the source is connected and each sensor gives usable signal

features.name: Live state readout with confidence bar and stream statistics
features.general: Show the latest predicted class for a sliding window, its confidence as a bar, and counters for processed and rejected windows and how old the decision is
features.specific: 🎯 Cognitive State (Prediction pill such as 'Relaxed', Confidence Score bar such as 47%, Last updated time) with 📊 Statistics (Windows, Rejected, Decision age). Decision age is cut off on screen and has no tooltip; the full value is only in the page's accessibility tree. In this run Windows rose only on manual rerun
steps: Start a stream and wait about 4 s for the first window
Read the predicted state and confidence
Rerun to pull new windows and watch Windows rise
Check that Rejected stays at 0 before trusting the label
serves_tasks: See the predicted state and its confidence for the latest window, and check how many windows were rejected
Repeat the classification for each labelled recording and compare the outputs

features.name: Stacked multichannel trace viewer
features.general: Plot several time-series channels stacked with vertical offsets, with legend toggles to hide or isolate channels, box-zoom, hover readout, reset and PNG export
features.specific: 📈 EEG Signal Plotly chart of TP9/AF7/AF8/TP10 against elapsed time (s), offset for readability. Click a legend item to hide it, double-click to isolate one, drag to zoom, hover for (t, µV), double-click to zoom out, camera icon saves newplot.png
steps: Click a channel in the legend to hide it
Double-click a channel to isolate it
Drag across the plot to zoom into a time span
Hover a point to read time and value
Double-click to reset, and download a PNG with the camera icon

features.name: Refresh-rate control for a live dashboard

features.specific: Auto-refresh checkbox and Refresh interval slider (0.50–5.00 s). Press R or use ⋮ → Rerun to pull new windows by hand. Periodic refresh stalled here because every run ended on the decision-log ImportError. Pressing R while a sidebar selectbox has focus types 'r' into it instead of rerunning
steps: Tick or untick Auto-refresh
Set the interval on the slider
Click outside the sidebar controls, then press R (or ⋮ → Rerun) to pick up new windows
serves_tasks: Option: control how often the display updates

features.name: Per-window decision log
features.general: Keep a bounded table of recent window decisions (time, predicted class, confidence, artifact ratio) so a run can be audited after the fact
features.specific: 🗒️ Recent Decisions table (decision_log.py, st.dataframe) with window, time, prediction, confidence and artifact ratio columns. It shows no per-feature contributions. Not rendered in this run: 'ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4' replaces it as soon as one decision exists. This is an environment version clash, not an app limitation
steps: Start a stream and wait for the first decision
Scroll below the EEG Signal panel to the Recent Decisions table
Read prediction, confidence and artifact ratio for recent windows
serves_tasks: Review the recent per-window decisions to audit the classification history

screens_never_reached: 🗒️ Recent Decisions table (bounded log of window, time, prediction, confidence and artifact ratio). As soon as one decision exists, rendering it with st.dataframe raises 'ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4' (decision_log.py line 35). This is an environment issue (NumPy 1.26 vs pyarrow), not an app limitation. The script stops there, so the log never appears and auto-refresh stops after the first decision (screens/006.webp, screens/008.webp).

🎵 Focus Music panel while decisions exist: it sits below the crashing log. With no decisions it renders, and the Relaxation button only reports 'No .mp3 file found in src/music/relaxation/' (screens/030.webp).
LSL streaming state with live Muse data: no hardware or LSL stream was available, so only the 🔴 error state was reached (screens/037.webp, screens/043.webp).
Muse device discovery results: the Search Muse button says discovery is not implemented yet (screens/039.webp).
not_done: Inspecting which band-power features drove a classification and by how much: the dashboard has no view for this at all. The Recent Decisions log shows only window, time, prediction, confidence and artifact ratio, and the Statistics panel shows only counts. This goal cannot be reached by design, apart from the crash.

Reviewing the per-window decision history and artifact ratios: the Recent Decisions table crashes with the pyarrow/NumPy ImportError (an environment issue) as soon as one decision exists (screens/006.webp, screens/008.webp).

Judging whether the classifier separates the labelled states: all three seed recordings came out 'Relaxed' (concentrating 47%, relaxed 81%, neutral 96%). They are 0.4 s synthetic files generated by the run harness, not real EEG. The result is therefore not evidence about the method's separation of states either way.

Continuous hands-free auto-refresh: because the decision-log crash ends every script run, auto-refresh stops after the first decision. New windows only appeared after pressing R (screens/010.webp, screens/048.webp).
Searching for Muse devices: the 🔍 Search Muse button only reports 'Muse device discovery is not implemented yet' (screens/039.webp).
Streaming live data from a real Muse over LSL: no device was present.
Playing focus music: no .mp3 files are shipped (screens/030.webp). The panel plays music by hand per state and is not tied to predictions, so it was left out of the tree on purpose as auxiliary.
Uploading my own EEG CSV: the interface has no upload widget and only lists files already in data/raw/.
Display oddity: the looped 0.4 s buffer draws a straight line back across each channel in the trace (screens/024.webp), which looks like a wrap-around artifact. I did not investigate it further.
